title: Camera Path Spline Keyframe Editor with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a camera path spline keyframe editor with full undo/redo support.

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a 3D scene with a ground grid (GridHelper, size 100, divisions 20) and 5-7 simple landmark objects (colored boxes/spheres/cones) scattered around the scene so the camera path has interesting things to look at.
- Use an OrbitControls-driven editor camera (perspective, fov 60) starting at position (20, 15, 20) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (10, 20, 10).
- The scene background should be a dark gradient or color (0x1a1a2e).

SPLINE PATH SYSTEM:
- Maintain an ordered array of keyframes. Each keyframe stores: position (Vector3), lookAt target (Vector3), and a timestamp (seconds, auto-assigned as index * 2.0).
- Render the spline path using THREE.CatmullRomCurve3 through all keyframe positions, visualized as a yellow TubeGeometry (radius 0.08, 200 segments).
- Each keyframe is shown as a small sphere (radius 0.4): green for unselected, red for selected.
- Draw a thin blue line from each keyframe sphere to its lookAt target (shown as a small cyan sphere, radius 0.2).
- Start with 3 default keyframes: K0 at pos(0,3,10) lookAt(0,0,0), K1 at pos(8,5,5) lookAt(0,1,0), K2 at pos(10,3,-5) lookAt(0,0,-5).

KEYFRAME EDITING:
- Click on a keyframe sphere to select it (turns red). Only one keyframe selected at a time.
- When a keyframe is selected, show a DOM panel (#keyframe-panel) with X/Y/Z position inputs and lookAtX/lookAtY/lookAtZ inputs, plus a 'Delete Keyframe' button.
- Editing the input fields and pressing Enter or clicking an 'Apply' button updates the keyframe position/lookAt and re-generates the spline. Each apply is an undoable action.
- Press 'A' key to add a new keyframe at the midpoint between the last two keyframes (or at (0,3,0) if fewer than 2 exist). This is undoable.
- Press 'Delete' key to delete the selected keyframe (if one is selected). This is undoable.

PLAYBACK SYSTEM:
- A 'Play' button (#play-btn) starts animating a preview camera (shown as a small wireframe frustum in the scene) along the spline path. The preview camera interpolates position AND lookAt along the spline over totalDuration = (keyframes.length - 1) * 2.0 seconds.
- During playback, update a progress bar (#progress-bar, a div whose inner div width% reflects progress) and a time label (#time-label) showing current time in format '0.0s / totalDuration s'.
- A 'Stop' button (#stop-btn) stops playback and resets to t=0.
- playbackProgress is a float 0.0 to 1.0.

UNDO/REDO SYSTEM:
- Maintain an undo stack and redo stack of state snapshots (deep copies of the keyframes array).
- Before every mutating action (add, delete, edit-apply), push current state to undo stack and clear redo stack.
- Press Ctrl+Z to undo: pop from undo stack, push current to redo stack, restore.
- Press Ctrl+Y to redo: pop from redo stack, push current to undo stack, restore.
- Show undo/redo stack sizes in a HUD element (#undo-redo-hud) as text like 'Undo: N | Redo: M'.

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
Expose and continuously update:
- keyframeCount: number of keyframes
- selectedKeyframeIndex: index of selected keyframe or -1
- selectedKeyframePos: {x,y,z} of selected keyframe or null
- selectedKeyframeLookAt: {x,y,z} of selected keyframe lookAt or null
- splinePointCount: number of points sampled on the spline curve (should be ~200)
- isPlaying: boolean
- playbackProgress: float 0.0-1.0
- playbackTime: float current time in seconds
- totalDuration: float total animation duration
- undoStackSize: number
- redoStackSize: number
- lastAction: string describing last action ('init','add','delete','edit','undo','redo','play','stop')
- previewCameraPos: {x,y,z} of the preview camera frustum during playback
- splineCurveExists: boolean, true if TubeGeometry is in the scene
- keyframePositions: array of {x,y,z} for all keyframes

UI ELEMENTS:
- #play-btn, #stop-btn buttons at top-left
- #progress-bar container (200px wide, 10px tall, gray bg) with inner #progress-fill (green bg, width% = progress)
- #time-label showing playback time
- #undo-redo-hud showing stack sizes
- #keyframe-panel (hidden when no selection) with labeled inputs: #input-x, #input-y, #input-z, #input-lx, #input-ly, #input-lz, #apply-btn, #delete-kf-btn
- Style all UI with dark semi-transparent backgrounds, white text, positioned as overlays.
physics_constraints: Spline interpolation must produce continuous smooth paths. Keyframe positions must remain finite (no NaN/Infinity). Playback progress must be clamped [0,1]. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous states (position values must match exactly). Total duration must equal (keyframeCount-1)*2.0. Preview camera must lie on the spline curve at the interpolated parameter.
